meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 审代码时每条发现只写一行:位置、问题、修复,可选加 🔴 bug、🟡 risk、🔵 nit、❓ q 等严重度前缀。只输出可直接粘进 PR 的评语,不改代码、不批准或拒绝、不跑 linter。
howto.when: 当你说 /caveman-review,或提出「review this PR」、「review the diff」等要求时触发;说「stop caveman-review」或「normal mode」可退出。

say.note: 每条发现压成一行:位置、问题、修复

say.text: review the diff,用 caveman 格式
say.note: 多文件 diff 会带上 文件:L行号

howto.what_en: Claude reviews code in one-line findings: location, problem, fix, with optional severity prefixes (🔴 bug, 🟡 risk, 🔵 nit, ❓ q). Output is comments ready to paste into the PR; it does not write fixes, approve, or run linters.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /caveman-review, or asks like "review this PR" or "review the diff". Say "stop caveman-review" or "normal mode" to revert.

say_en.note: One line per finding: location, problem, fix
